points.point: Bluesky video post stuck in-progress for 2 days
Already polling GET /v2/posts/:id every few hours with the same result
Video is 40s mp4, 12 MB, and the URL opens

verdict.reason: The customer already tried repeated polling and the post still shows in-progress after 2 days, which is a case that still fails after trying and needs an account-level status check; the closest entry, "in-progress", depends on a live lookup result it cannot supply, and the other entries cover different questions (media limits, container format, Slack limits, analytics).
